To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) digital storytelling has the potential to be used as a tool for learning in formal education, 2) this potential can be fully exploited by aligning DST experiences with the pedagogical objectives and curriculum of the school, 3) this alignment can be achieved through a design process which involves researchers, teachers, and students, 4) the educational value of the DST experience can be measured by the extent to which it contributes to the achievement of the pedagogical goals.

1) digital storytelling can be conceptualised as an educational activity that is aligned to the pedagogy of the school, 2) this conceptualisation can be operationalised by means of the DSTEA framework, and 3) the DSTEA framework is a viable approach that can be used to integrate digital storytelling in formal education.

digital storytelling is an emerging area of research and practice that can be effectively integrated into formal education by conceptualising it as an educational activity and designing it as a pedagogical tool.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how digital storytelling can become an educational activity, and how it can be integrated in formal education.
the design and implementation of educational experiences based on digital storytelling, with the goal of enhancing students’ learning and engagement in formal learning contexts.
the educational value of digital storytelling as a pedagogical approach, and with the design and implementation of DST experiences in educational settings.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the educational potential that digital storytelling holds can be best exploited through its conceptualisation as a pedagogical activity, designed with a view on reaching specific educational objectives and implemented in formal educational settings.

the educational potential that digital storytelling has to offer to schools and universities is not fully exploited, and that DSTEA is a viable framework to bridge the gap between innovation and implementation.

the DSTEA framework is a viable and promising solution for the integration of digital storytelling in formal education, and a useful tool in the hands of educators and researchers interested in exploring the educational potential of this emerging practice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

DST can become a powerful tool for education when integrated into formal educational settings, but that this requires a shift from the traditional focus on digital storytelling as a creative process to its conceptualisation as a structured educational activity, designed with a view of reaching specific educational objectives and implemented in collaboration between teachers and researchers.
DSTEA is a design framework for integrating digital storytelling in formal education.

the educational potential and value of DST can be fully realised by its implementation as part of the pedagogical process, and by the design of DST experiences that are tailored to the needs of specific educational contexts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the educational value of DST lies in its potential to support the development of critical and creative thinking skills, and to foster students’ sense of agency in learning.
the potential of digital storytelling for education is best harnessed through its integration as an educational activity in formal educational contexts.
DST can become an effective pedagogical tool, if it is designed as an educational experience, and not just a research project.
